highlights.description: New OpenAPI 3 spec diffing: compare two specs across endpoints, operation IDs, and schema names, with a matching `oas3diff` CLI. Endpoints are compared generically (path variables normalized) so operationId renames do not mask shared endpoints.

added.description: `openapi3.SpecMetadataDiff` with `SpecsDiff`, `ReadSpecsDiff`, and `SpecMetadata.Diff`/`Difference` to report the endpoints, operation IDs, and schema names unique to each of two specs and those shared

tests.description: Cover `SpecsDiff` across endpoints, operation IDs, and schema names, including that a renamed operationId on a shared endpoint is not reported as an endpoint difference
